# A function whose body contains a lambda that calls an async native is
# itself colored async.  The generated JS must emit "async function outer".

sngl compile --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The enclosing function is async because its lambda body calls async.
grep 'async function outer' out/index.html

# The async call inside the lambda is awaited.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import api "js://./api"

func outer() {
    var f = func() { api.fetchHello("x") }
    f()
}

component main {
    button(text="Go", @click { outer() })
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(url: string): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
